'''Coruscant sauce supreme''' was one of the many specialties of [[Porcellus/Legends|Porcellus]], who was employed as the personal chef of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] until the crimelord's death. The recipe may have originated from the [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|ecumenopolis]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].
